title: Ill-posedness in the critical Sobolev space for the hyperelastic rod equation
summary: This article is the third in a series investigating ill-posedness in critical Sobolev spaces for Camassa-Holm-type equations. Following results for the $b$-Novikov and Fokas-Olver-Rosenau-Qiao equations, we study the hyperelastic rod equation at the critical Sobolev regularity $H^{3/2}(\mathbb R)$. We prove ill-posedness at this endpoint, complementing the local well-posedness theory in $H^s(\mathbb R)$ for $s>3/2$ and the recently established norm-inflation result for $1 3$, we construct solutions with arbitrarily small $H^{3/2}$ initial data whose $H^{3/2}$ norm becomes arbitrarily large…
